concept: Seafront billboard field with suspended figures
creativeDirection: Daylight location photography stages the sleeve portraits and graphic motifs in one physically plausible seafront field installation, using crisp midday sun and real constructed objects rather than collage or illustration.
scene: A wide 16:9 coastal field beside the sea viewed from slightly low eye level, with dry grass in the foreground, open water and a pale horizon beyond, and a single large tree trunk anchoring the right edge. The location contains a temporary outdoor installation of giant suspended block forms, a freestanding blue panel, striped fabric screens, and one tall glowing cutout structure set across the field.

elements.element: the woman from reference image 1 stands in profile beside the tree at the right edge, looking left across the field with her shoulder bag, preserving the original pose and framing logic
the woman from reference image 2 appears once on a freestanding matte blue panel as if photographed upside down within it, arms stretched upward toward the top edge of the panel
the anatomical exposed-musculature motif becomes a large printed translucent scrim stretched inside one of the suspended block structures, with eye-like flame details visible in sunlight

many people from reference image 4 in matching dark jumpsuits are scattered through the dry grass with one man prominent in the foreground, while giant 3D block forms hang above and red-white-blue radiating stripe screens converge toward the distant horizon
real lemon slices are pinned or resting on splattered painted boards placed among the grass near the foreground, adding sharp yellow accents
the dense abstract patchwork becomes the surface pattern on the tall central cutout-like structure, with a bright warm opening shape glowing through its middle

the minimal two blue lines appear as thin cables or painted stripes near the top of a white installation wall, and the small insect-like emblem is embossed on a low pale plinth in the lower right area

the person from reference image 8 appears once as a large star-speckled upward-looking portrait on a vertical dark panel positioned deeper in the field, catching light while retaining the cosmic blue-violet surface

coverSummaries.description: A soft-focus color photograph of a wide grassy field by the sea. At the right edge, a large tree trunk frames the scene, and a young woman stands beside it in profile, looking left across the field. She wears a dark short-sleeved top and dark pants and carries a shoulder bag. In the distance are a few small figures, several palm trees, a low wall, and a domed structure near the shoreline under a pale sky.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: woman standing beside a tree in a seaside field
coverSummaries.people: one woman standing in profile near a tree, with a few tiny distant figures in the field

coverSummaries.album: Free Your Mind and Your Ass Will Follow
coverSummaries.description: A studio-style photograph against a flat blue background showing an upside-down woman centered at the bottom, her face tilted upward toward the viewer and both bare arms stretched high and outward. Her hands are open with long fingers splayed, and her dark hair spreads around her head near the lower edge.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: upside-down woman with both arms raised
coverSummaries.people: one woman upside down with arms extended upward

coverSummaries.description: A dense surreal illustration centered on a flayed anatomical human figure in side profile, showing exposed muscles, veins, and tendons. One hand is raised at the left, and several eye-like flame shapes appear on the body and hand. Behind the figure are glowing circular forms, radiating patterns, and a ring of repeated stylized eyes around the border, all in a highly detailed psychedelic composition.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: anatomical human figure with exposed musculature

coverSummaries.description: A composite-style cover showing a field of dry grass filled with many people wearing matching dark jumpsuits. One man stands prominently in the foreground while numerous others are scattered behind him. Huge three-dimensional block forms dominate the upper left and center, and the background is a graphic burst of red, white, and blue rays converging toward a bright point on the horizon. Small birds appear at left.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: crowd in dark uniforms beneath giant 3D block forms and radiating stripes
coverSummaries.people: many people in matching dark jumpsuits standing across a field, with one man prominent in front

coverSummaries.description: An abstract action-painting style image covered in layered splatters, drips, and looping lines. The background is mostly green, white, gray, and black with three horizontal paint swatches at left in red-orange, off-white, and blue. Three yellow lemon slices are placed across the composition, one near the center and two toward the lower right.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: lemon slices on a splattered abstract painting
coverSummaries.medium: painting with collage-like photographic fruit elements

coverSummaries.description: A highly detailed abstract drawing made of interlocking patchwork shapes, grids, lines, and architectural-looking fragments in dark earthy tones. Near the center is a brighter irregular opening or silhouette-like shape filled with warmer oranges, reds, and pale tones, standing out from the darker surrounding maze of forms.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: bright central cutout-like shape within a dense abstract patchwork

coverSummaries.description: A very minimal cover with a plain white background. Near the top are two thin horizontal blue lines separating large empty space, and in the lower right corner there is a small embossed circular emblem containing a simple insect-like figure. The overall composition is sparse and clean.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: small embossed insect-like emblem in the lower right corner

coverSummaries.description: A dark cosmic-style image showing a close-up human face and upper body turned upward, almost submerged in darkness and covered with countless star-like speckles. The figure glows in deep blue and violet tones against a black background, creating the impression of a body blended with a night sky or galaxy.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: star-speckled human face and torso emerging from darkness
coverSummaries.people: one person shown in close-up, head tilted upward and body covered in star-like speckles

prompt: A wide coastal field beside the sea in hard midday sun, photographed from slightly low eye level in a crisp 16:9 editorial location shot, with dry grass in the foreground, open water and pale horizon beyond, and a large tree trunk framing the right edge; the woman from reference image 1 stands beside the tree in profile looking left across the field with her shoulder bag, kept exactly as her sleeve pose and expression. Across the field, many people from reference image 4 wearing matching dark jumpsuits stand scattered through the grass with one man prominent in the foreground, while huge suspended 3D block forms dominate the upper left and center and red, white, and blue radiating stripe screens converge toward a bright point near the horizon, with a few small birds at left. Include a freestanding matte blue panel in the installation containing the woman from reference image 2 once, upside down with both arms raised and fingers splayed, preserving her exact portrait orientation and framing. Deeper in the field place one tall vertical dark panel showing the person from reference image 8 once, head tilted upward and body covered with star-like speckles in deep blue and violet. Transform the anatomical figure from reference image 3 into a large translucent printed scrim stretched inside one suspended block form, showing exposed musculature and eye-like flame details. Use the abstract patchwork from reference image 6 as the surface of a tall central cutout structure with a bright warm opening shape through its middle. In the near foreground place splattered painted boards derived from reference image 5 with real lemon slices resting on or pinned to them. Add a minimal white installation wall carrying two thin horizontal blue lines near its top from reference image 7, and a small pale plinth in the lower right embossed with the insect-like emblem. Photographic realism, physically plausible outdoor art installation, sharp medium-format detail, clean edges, no haze, no fog, no collage look. Strong clear visual hierarchy with the tree-side woman and foreground crowd leading, the giant forms and stripe screens shaping the space, and the other motifs as supporting installations. Palette of dry tan grass, sea blue, white, signal red, deep blue-violet, brown, black, and lemon yellow; mood graphic, sun-struck, spacious, and slightly surreal but fully daylight-real. Reference map for people (the album images are attached in this numbered order): reference image 1 shows one woman standing in profile near a tree, with a few tiny distant figures in the field; reference image 2 shows one woman upside down with arms extended upward; reference image 4 shows many people in matching dark jumpsuits standing across a field, with one man prominent in front; reference image 8 shows one person shown in close-up, head tilted upward and body covered in star-like speckles. Copy each of these faces directly from that numbered reference image - same face, hair, expression, and styling - rather than drawing a new person from the description. Hard constraints (override any conflicting source material): Create a single cohesive 16:9 image, not a grid, contact sheet, row of covers, or collage of separate panels. Do not reproduce the album sleeves as framed thumbnails; transform their non-text visual motifs into one original composition. Include no readable text or lettering of any kind: no words, letters, numbers, code, glyphs, captions, titles, logos, watermarks, labels, or signage. Feature only adults and avoid gore, wounds, body horror, medical or anatomical imagery, blank or milky eyes, nudity, sexual content, weapons, and hate symbols; reinterpret any sensitive source motif abstractly. When a source includes a person, closely match their visible appearance and likeness to the reference image, preserving recognisable facial features, hair, skin tone, clothing, and styling. Keep each reference person in the pose, expression, and gaze the sleeve shows, and keep every identifiable face sharp, lit, unobscured, and in focus: no motion blur, long-exposure smearing, steam, fog, shadow, crowding, or shallow depth of field over a reference person's face. Expose the image brightly and cleanly: open, readable shadows and clear colour, with no murky underexposure, crushed blacks, heavy film grain, digital noise, or dust-and-scratches texture. Depict each identifiable reference person only once in the entire composition; do not repeat or clone them as another figure, reflection, mirror portrait, poster, billboard, screen, photograph, painting, silhouette, or background face. The only exception is repetition visibly intrinsic to one source cover: keep that repetition within that single source motif and do not echo the person elsewhere.
